title: Candidate-Bound Mechanical Trust Integration
implemented_contracts: stable canonical JSON hashing independent of object key insertion order
candidate revision SHA-256 and candidate artifact SHA-256 binding
explicit Git source_revision binding with caller-supplied expected revision validation
strict Mechanical Trust Report schema with epistemic_scope=mechanical_only
mechanical PASS derived only from all scoped gate results passing
report schema forbids mathematical truth and canonical authority fields
gate results retain only output hashes, exit code, duration, command identity and tool provenance
shell-free command execution for deterministic leaf gates
12-gate repository mechanical registry plus one internal Candidate Envelope gate
Lean source gate explicitly scoped as not formal compilation
candidate mutation during verification invalidates the whole report
executor result gate_id/scope/executable/args/tool name must remain bound to the declared gate definition
live integration validator runs the current deterministic repository checks and emits a candidate/source-bound report

tdd_regression_evidence.case: stale source revision must invalidate an otherwise hash-matching report
tdd_regression_evidence.red_result: FAIL as expected: stale source_revision was accepted

tdd_regression_evidence.case: integration entrypoint must execute the live mechanical trust report path
tdd_regression_evidence.red_result: FAIL as expected: validate-mechanical-trust.mjs did not exist

tdd_regression_evidence.case: executor may not amplify or rewrite declared verification scope
tdd_regression_evidence.red_result: FAIL as expected through repository_tests gate after scope-amplification regression was introduced

known_boundary.source_revision_semantics: Git commit identity; R4 does not claim a clean/unmodified working tree content hash
known_boundary.lean_mechanical_scope: lean_source_gate is source-level only; separate Lean CI supplies formal-build evidence
known_boundary.candidate_semantics: R4 binds repository mechanical checks to a protocol-level candidate revision; semantic mathematical verification is outside R4

final_head_verification.reason: the validation artifact creates a new branch HEAD and must independently pass OCME CI and Lean CI

acceptance_rule: R4 is FINAL_ACCEPTED only after the validation-artifact HEAD passes both OCME CI and Lean CI.
